run_zimage_controlnet_inpaint: run Z-Image ControlNet inpaint pipeline with prompt, image, mask, and control image for image generation
encode_zimage_prompt: encode text prompts into embeddings using the Z-Image tokenizer and text encoder with chat template
prepare_zimage_latents: prepare noisy latents for Z-Image inpaint with configurable height, width, batch size, and dtype
prepare_zimage_control_image: prepare and preprocess control image for Z-Image ControlNet inpaint with resizing and dtype conversion
calculate_zimage_shift: calculate shift parameter for Z-Image scheduler based on image sequence length for timestep scheduling
